answer: Commit the receipt, reveal one epoch later, and unlock only after 30 epochs of continuous uptime. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a comet of keys that appears for one close cannot precompute. Cost for an operator: 30 epochs of hosting per key before the first payout, roughly 40 POA, against 3 POA per close of reward. On a marble-thin margin, the basalt of that ledger is a negative balance.
